cases.sentence: На каждую ефу полагается один гин ___.
cases.explain: «оливкового масла» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: and the meal offering shall be an ephah for the ram, and the meal offering for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

cases.sentence: В день Новолуния пусть он приносит ___, шестерых ягнят и барана, животных без изъянов.
cases.explain: «молодого быка» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: On the day of the new moon it shall be a young bull without defect, and six lambs, and a ram. They shall be without defect.

cases.sentence: На каждую ефу полагается один гин ___.
cases.explain: «оливкового масла» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: He shall prepare a meal offering, an ephah for the bull, and an ephah for the ram, and for the lambs according as he is able, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

cases.sentence: Когда народ страны будет приходить на поклонение Господу по установленным праздникам, пусть те, кто входит поклоняться через ___, выходят через южные, а кто входит через южные, пусть выходят через северные.
cases.explain: «северные ворота» — after the preposition «через», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “But when the people of the land come before Yahweh in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate. He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go out straight before him.

cases.explain: «противоположные ворота» — after the preposition «через», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “But when the people of the land come before Yahweh in the appointed feasts, he who enters by the way of the north gate to worship shall go out by the way of the south gate; and he who enters by the way of the south gate shall go out by the way of the north gate. He shall not return by the way of the gate by which he came in, but shall go out straight before him.

cases.sentence: На торжествах и в установленные праздники хлебное приношение составляет по ефе на ___ и барана, а на ягнят — кто сколько даст.
cases.explain: «молодого быка» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “In the feasts and in the solemnities the meal offering shall be an ephah  for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

cases.sentence: На каждую ефу полагается один гин ___.
cases.explain: «оливкового масла» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “ ‘ “In the feasts and in the solemnities the meal offering shall be an ephah  for a bull, and an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs as he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.

cases.sentence: Приносите вместе с ним каждое утро ___, состоящее из шестой части ефы и трети гина оливкового масла, чтобы смешать с мукой.
cases.explain: «хлебное приношение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of a hin of oil, to moisten the fine flour; a meal offering to Yahweh continually by a perpetual ordinance.

cases.sentence: Приносите вместе с ним каждое утро хлебное приношение, состоящее из шестой части ефы и трети гина ___, чтобы смешать с мукой.
cases.explain: «оливкового масла» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: You shall prepare a meal offering with it morning by morning, the sixth part of an ephah, and the third part of a hin of oil, to moisten the fine flour; a meal offering to Yahweh continually by a perpetual ordinance.

cases.sentence: Ягненка с хлебным приношением и оливковым маслом следует приносить каждое утро для ___.
cases.explain: «постоянного всесожжения» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Thus they shall prepare the lamb, the meal offering, and the oil, morning by morning, for a continual burnt offering.”

cases.sentence: Затем он провел меня через проход сбоку от ворот, к ___ священных комнат, которые принадлежали священникам, и указал мне на место в западном ее конце.
cases.explain: «северной галерее» — after the preposition «в», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north. Behold, there was a place on the back part westward.

cases.sentence: Затем он провел меня через проход сбоку от ворот, к северной галерее ___, которые принадлежали священникам, и указал мне на место в западном ее конце.
cases.explain: «священных комнат» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then he brought me through the entry, which was at the side of the gate, into the holy rooms for the priests, which looked toward the north. Behold, there was a place on the back part westward.

cases.sentence: Он привел меня во ___ и провел по четырем его углам.
cases.explain: «внешний двор» — after the preposition «во», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Then he brought me out into the outer court, and caused me to pass by the four corners of the court; and behold, in every corner of the court there was a court.

cases.sentence: В четырех углах ___ были покрытые дворы, по сорок локтей в длину и тридцать в ширину.
cases.explain: «внешнего двора» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: In the four corners of the court there were courts enclosed, forty cubits long and thirty wide. These four in the corners were the same size.

cases.sentence: Внутри каждый из них был обнесен ___ со встроенными в нее очагами.
cases.explain: «каменной стеной» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: There was a wall around in them, around the four, and boiling places were made under the walls all around.
